introHtml: Fleece medical healthcare items offer a soft, warm alternative to standard cotton or polyester giveaways. From heathered fleece blankets for patient comfort to branded sherpa throws for fundraising events, fleece provides a cozy touch that recipients appreciate. Decorate with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a professional finish. Ideal for healthcare facilities, wellness programs, and corporate health initiatives looking to combine practicality with warmth.
